From c9ace69cff4a626c9e1c21181cd2b957ae2a3fb0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Suresh Srinivas <suresh@apache.org>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2013 07:42:06 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] HADOOP-9563. Fix incompatibility introduced by HADOOP-9523.
 Contributed by Tian Hong Wang.

git-svn-id: https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/hadoop/common/trunk@1482709 13f79535-47bb-0310-9956-ffa450edef68

diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
index 819a9216bd9..24846f849a5 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@
  * A helper class for getting build-info of the java-vm. 
  * 
  */
-@InterfaceAudience.Private
+@InterfaceAudience.LimitedPrivate({"HBase"})
 @InterfaceStability.Unstable
 public class PlatformName {
   /**
@@ -49,7 +49,6 @@
   public static final boolean IBM_JAVA = JAVA_VENDOR_NAME.contains("IBM");
   
   public static void main(String[] args) {
-    System.out.println("platform name: " + PLATFORM_NAME);
-    System.out.println("java vendor name: " + JAVA_VENDOR_NAME);
+    System.out.println(PLATFORM_NAME);
   }
 }
--

index 805258f566d..79df6e07245 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt

     (tom and todd via todd)
 
+    HADOOP-9563. Fix incompatibility introduced by HADOOP-9523.
+    (Tian Hong Wang via suresh)
+
 Release 2.0.4-alpha - 2013-04-25 
 
   INCOMPATIBLE CHANGES

### Modifications in Each File

1. **PlatformName.java**
   - The annotation `@InterfaceAudience.Private` was changed to `@InterfaceAudience.LimitedPrivate({"HBase"})`, indicating that the class is now intended for limited private use, specifically for HBase.
   - Two lines in the `main` method that printed the platform name and Java vendor name were modified. The print statement for the Java vendor name was removed, and the print statement for the platform name was simplified to just print `PLATFORM_NAME`.

2. **CHANGES.txt**
   - A new entry was added to document the fix for the incompatibility introduced by HADOOP-9523, specifically noting the issue as HADOOP-9563 and crediting Tian Hong Wang for the contribution.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The changes in `PlatformName.java` address a specific incompatibility issue that was introduced in a previous patch (HADOOP-9523). By modifying the audience annotation and simplifying the output in the `main` method, the patch aims to resolve the issues that arose from the earlier changes. The entry in `CHANGES.txt` serves to inform users and developers about this fix, linking it directly to the previous incompatibility and providing credit to the contributor. This relationship highlights the ongoing effort to maintain compatibility and stability within the Hadoop project.
